paraphrase: Abhinavagupta praises in turn the goddesses of the sequence: Sṛṣṭi, Raktā, Sthitināśā, [Yama], Saṃhāra, Mṛtyu, and the rest, up to Mahākālī who reckons all time and the goddess of perfect fullness in whom the knower, the means, the measure and the whole world rest.
